from solution import areEquivalent


def test_issue_example_36_57():
    """Example requires areEquivalent(36,57) to be False."""
    # sigma(36)=1+2+3+4+6+9+12+18+36=91, sigma(57)=1+3+19+57=80
    assert areEquivalent(36, 57) == False


def test_issue_same_value_true():
    """Same inputs have same divisor sum so are equivalent."""
    # sigma(6)=1+2+3+6=12 on both sides
    assert areEquivalent(6, 6) == True


def test_issue_smallest_identical_true():
    """Smallest input 1 is equivalent to itself."""
    # sigma(1)=1 on both sides
    assert areEquivalent(1, 1) == True


def test_issue_equivalent_6_11():
    """Distinct numbers with same divisor sum are equivalent."""
    # sigma(6)=1+2+3+6=12, sigma(11)=1+11=12
    assert areEquivalent(6, 11) == True


def test_issue_equivalent_14_15():
    """Distinct numbers 14 and 15 share the same divisor sum."""
    # sigma(14)=1+2+7+14=24, sigma(15)=1+3+5+15=24
    assert areEquivalent(14, 15) == True


def test_issue_different_5_7():
    """Numbers with different divisor sums are not equivalent."""
    # sigma(5)=1+5=6, sigma(7)=1+7=8
    assert areEquivalent(5, 7) == False


def test_issue_different_6_7():
    """Neighbouring values 6 and 7 have different divisor sums."""
    # sigma(6)=1+2+3+6=12, sigma(7)=1+7=8
    assert areEquivalent(6, 7) == False


def test_issue_different_12_20():
    """Larger pair 12 and 20 have different divisor sums."""
    # sigma(12)=1+2+3+4+6+12=28, sigma(20)=1+2+4+5+10+20=42
    assert areEquivalent(12, 20) == False


def test_issue_different_2_3():
    """Small primes 2 and 3 have different divisor sums."""
    # sigma(2)=1+2=3, sigma(3)=1+3=4
    assert areEquivalent(2, 3) == False


def test_contract_result_is_bool():
    """Check function must return a boolean."""
    # sigma(36)=91, sigma(57)=80 so result is boolean False
    assert areEquivalent(36, 57) is False


def test_contract_swapped_args_same():
    """Swapping arguments must not change equivalence."""
    # sigma(15)=1+3+5+15=24, sigma(14)=1+2+7+14=24
    assert areEquivalent(15, 14) == True
